name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
steps: Grip a pull-up bar noticeably wider than shoulder-width with your palms facing away from you and hang with straight arms.
Set your shoulder blades down, brace your core, and keep your legs steady beneath you.
Pull your chest smoothly upward toward the bar by driving your elbows down and slightly inward until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly back to a full dead hang with complete control.
tips: Choose a width that allows your elbows to travel down comfortably without shoulder pinching.
Avoid kipping or swinging your legs to force your chin over the bar.
